visible_traits: Brown/dark body with a pale face/chest region and broad golden horn/antler-like forms.
A red health bar appears above this target while a cyan attack/contact effect reaches toward it from the green-bar player group.
observations.role_evidence: Red target health bar and opposed contact effect support combat-target status in these stills.
observations.cross_reference: YT01-O2 may describe this silhouette, but low-resolution pixels do not conclusively prove identity mapping.
observations.recommended_disposition: Include in source-to-render reconciliation as an observed hostile wildlife candidate. Use neutral label until source identity is corroborated.

observations.neutral_label: Bulky white-furred creature with gray face and red horn/crest tips
visible_traits: Broad pale body, gray/dark facial region, heavy arm/forelimb-like masses and red upper-head horn/crest tips.
Appears larger and much paler than the brown/gold combat target; seen in multiple later gameplay areas.
A red target health bar is clear in sheet22/cell0 beside attack/contact effects.
observations.role_evidence: Repeated encounter positioning and red target health bar support a combat-target role.
observations.recommended_disposition: Reconcile as a distinct visible silhouette/material candidate. Do not automatically equate with the previous blue crystalline Ice Brute, or assert separate species/tier without source corroboration.

visible_traits: Small blue human-shaped body, head and limbs in or beside icy patches.

observations.recommended_disposition: Do not add a snowman enemy based on these previews. Retain as an unresolved role observation if another source clarifies it.
